components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already has the
            same last name and address (same household). Write-only; not returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first
                three letters of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence
                (one more than the owners already in that city) assigned at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners that belong to the same household
                (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created with
                'sharesHousehold' true; null otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F60718'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key all duplicate detection is expressed through:
                normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + (householdId or empty).
                A create request is rejected with 409 only when its whole identityKey equals
                an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F60718'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and
                lastName (case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY
                is the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Assigned at creation
                time.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'

## Summary

I implemented optional, city-region-aware `postcode` validation for `POST /api/owners`, following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions.

**Contract / model**
- `openapi.yml` — added an optional `postcode` property (4-digit string) to the `OwnerFields` schema. Since `Owner` is `allOf OwnerFields`, it's bound from the request and returned in responses; MapStruct auto-maps it by name.
- `Owner.java` — added the `postcode` field with `@Column`, getter, and setter.
- `db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql` — added the `postcode` column (tests run on hsqldb).

**Validation pipeline**
- `ValidateOwnerPostcode.java` — new step reading `@Val OwnerFieldsDto`. Skips when postcode is null/blank (backward-compatible); rejects a present postcode that isn't exactly 4 digits; and, when the city maps to a known region (Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD), rejects values outside that region's range (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099). Unknown-region cities accept any 4-digit value.
- `InvalidPostcodeException.java` — checked exception for routing to escalation.
- `InvalidPostcodeExceptionHandler.java` + `escalation/...InvalidPostcodeException.yml` — respond 400 with the `{"errors":["postcode"]}` shape used by the other create-field errors.
- `owners.POST.yml` — wired `validatePostcode` in right after `validate`, before the normalize steps.

The three acceptance tests (stores a valid postcode, accepts an owner without one, rejects a malformed one) all pass, and nothing else regressed.

Note: I did not commit anything — this directory isn't a git repository, and you hadn't asked me to. Let me know if you'd like it initialized/committed.
